statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: bring a transaction from instantiation to the terminated state

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: When a connection is opened by the transport layer, this index is set to the destination IP, port and transport.
actions: set connection index to destination IP, port, and transport

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: When the connection is accepted by the transport layer, this index is set to the source IP address, port number, and transport.
actions: set connection index to source IP address, port number, and transport

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: It is RECOMMENDED that connections be kept open for some implementation-defined duration after the last message was sent or received over that connection. This duration SHOULD at least equal the longest amount of time the element would need in order to bring a transaction from instantiation to the terminated state.
statements.trigger: last message sent or received on connection
actions: keep connection open for implementation-defined duration (at minimum 64*T1)
